fields.name: seed
fields.description: Optional seed for reproducible readings. Same seed + same date = same hexagram every time. Pass any unique identifier (userId, email hash, session token) to give each user their own hexagram for the day. Without a seed every caller receives the same shared hexagram of the day.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date for the reading in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today (UTC). Useful for viewing past daily readings or pre-generating future ones.
